title: Polygonati Rhizoma Alleviates Vascular Dementia through Regulating Microglial Polarization Transitions Mediated by NF-kappaB/NLRP3 Pathway.
authors: Yuan, Yin; Li, Meng; Zhou, Tian; Chen, Xi; Li, Yihang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药黄精通过NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路调节小胶质细胞极化缓解血管性痴呆，仅涉及分子对接筛选靶点，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Polygonati rhizoma (PR) has been used for thousands of years to alleviate dementia. Here, we aimed to elucidate the effect of alleviating vascular dementia (VaD) and underlying mechanism of PR. METHODS: In vivo, rats were treated with two-vessel occlusion (2VO) induces VaD. The anti-VaD effect measured by learning and memory capacity, cerebral pathological structure, and cerebral microglial M1/M2 phenotype biomarkers. Subsequently, screening potential mechanisms of PR for VaD using network pharmacology and molecular docking methods. Moreover, the efficacy of PR-contained serum on LPS-induced inflammation and polarization on BV2 microglia was evaluated with NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway. RESULTS: In vivo, PR significantly enhanced learning and memory capacity, suppressed M1 microglia activation and promoted M2 polarization. Through network pharmacology and molecular docking approaches, we screened inflammation as a potential mechanism for PR anti-VaD, with targets involving NF-kappaB. Meanwhile, PR could regulate the expression of NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway compared with that of LPS-induced BV2 cells. Furthermore, by utilizing PDTC, an NF-kappaB antagonist, it was found that the effect of PR was similar to that of PDTC. CONCLUSION: PR could hamper inflammation and microglial polarization in 2VO-induced VaD and LPS-induced BV2 cells. Our results showed that PR was a promising Chinese herb to alleviate VaD, and the potential mechanism might be related to NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：黄精（Polygonati rhizoma, PR）数千年来一直被用于缓解痴呆。本研究旨在阐明其缓解血管性痴呆（vascular dementia, VaD）的作用及潜在机制。方法：在体内实验中，通过双侧颈总动脉闭塞（two-vessel occlusion, 2VO）诱导大鼠VaD模型，评估学习记忆能力、脑病理结构及脑小胶质细胞M1/M2表型生物标志物，以测定PR的抗VaD效果。随后，利用网络药理学和分子对接方法筛选PR治疗VaD的潜在机制。此外，评估含PR血清对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的BV2小胶质细胞炎症及极化的影响，并探讨NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路的作用。结果：在体内实验中，PR显著增强学习记忆能力，抑制M1小胶质细胞活化并促进M2极化。通过网络药理学和分子对接方法，筛选出炎症作为PR抗VaD的潜在机制，涉及NF-kappaB靶点。同时，与LPS诱导的BV2细胞相比，PR能调节NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路的表达。此外，利用NF-kappaB拮抗剂PDTC发现，PR的作用与PDTC相似。结论：PR能抑制2VO诱导的VaD和LPS诱导的BV2细胞中的炎症及小胶质细胞极化。结果表明，PR是一种有前景的缓解VaD的中药，其潜在机制可能与NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号通路相关。
